lines.vo: A big life change is a rare chance to reset your habits.
That's not chaos. That's a door left open.
So after her move, Tasha plans her new routine in her Life Reset Planner.
Habits run on cues, like the same street, the same kitchen, the same time.
When a move or a new job wipes those cues, the autopilot loses its script.
In one UK study, employees who had recently moved and cared about the environment drove to work less.
Researchers call this the habit discontinuity window, and it doesn't stay open forever.
New place, new cues, new plan. That's how you stay on track.
